title: Ohtani will be in Dodgers' Game 3 NLCS lineup, Roberts says - ESPN
description: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Tuesday that struggling superstar Shohei Ohtani will be in the lineup for Game 3 of the NLCS on Wednesday vs. the Milwaukee Brewers, and that he had a "great conversation" with the two-time NL MVP.

title: Texas DA says ICE intentionally hit immigrant with a car and may have withheld evidence - NBC News
description: Harris County DA Sean Teare told NBC News his office has collected multiple videos for its own investigation but isn’t getting cooperation from the federal government.
